hypotheses.R0_gauge_normalization_is_invariant: A legal bilinear channel rescaling preserves logits and changes neither RMS- nor standard-deviation-normalized chart metrics by more than 1e-4.
hypotheses.R1_common_panel_rms_load_gap: For both paired seeds, the common-panel RMS-normalized Layer-0 effective rank at rho=0 is at most 80 percent of rho=1.
hypotheses.R2_common_panel_std_load_gap: The same early-rank contrast survives standard-deviation normalization in both paired seeds.
hypotheses.R3_common_panel_dictionary_gap: For both paired seeds, rho=0 RMS-normalized Layer-0 rank-16 reconstruction fidelity exceeds rho=1 by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.R4_arbitrary_geometry_is_closer_to_untra: At Layer 0, rho=1 RMS-normalized effective rank is closer to an untrained network than rho=0 is, in both seeds.
hypotheses.R5_half_arbitrary_is_already_high_rank: At Layer 0, rho=0.5 RMS-normalized effective rank is at least twice rho=0 and at least 80 percent of rho=1 in both seeds.
hypotheses.R6_load_contrast_persists_upstream: For both seeds, rho=0 has lower RMS-normalized effective rank than rho=1 in Layers 0 through 2.
